description_en: Queries the information about instances in a manually triggered workflow
description_zh: 获取手动执行的业务流程实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-manual-dag-instances --project-env RPOD --project-name test_workspace --dag-id 7000001231241 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListManualDagInstances

parameters.help_en: The environment of Operation Center. Valid values: PROD and DEV
parameters.help_zh: 运维中心的调度环境标识，包括PROD（生产环境）和DEV（开发环境）
parameters.name: project_env

parameters.help_en: The name of the workspace to which the manually triggered workflow belongs. You can log on to the DataWorks console (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to obtain the name
parameters.help_zh: 手动业务流程所属的工作空间名称。您可以进入DataWorks控制台 (https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，在工作空间配置页面获取
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the directed acyclic graph (DAG) for the manually triggered workflow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212830.html operation to obtain the ID
parameters.help_zh: 触发手动业务流程运行的Dag实例ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212830.html接口获取
parameters.name: dag_id

Instances.description_en: The instances in the manually triggered workflow
Instances.description_zh: 手动业务流程的内部实例列表

BeginRunningTime.description_en: The time when the instance started to run
BeginRunningTime.description_zh:
实例任务开始运行的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

BeginWaitResTime.description_en: The time when the instance started to wait for resources
BeginWaitResTime.description_zh:
实例任务开始等待资源的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

BeginWaitTimeTime.description_en: The time when the instance started to wait to be scheduled
BeginWaitTimeTime.description_zh:
实例任务开始等待调度的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

BizDate.description_en: The data timestamp of the instance. In most cases, the value is one day before the time when the instance was run
BizDate.description_zh:
业务日期。通常为该任务运行时间的前一天。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the instance was generated
CreateTime.description_zh:
实例任务的创建时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

CreateUser.description_en: The name of the account that is used to run the instance. For example, if you use an account named Test to run the instance, the value of this parameter is Test
CreateUser.description_zh: 触发实例运行的用户。例如，用户Test触发运行手动执行的业务流程实例，则CreateUser为Test

CycTime.description_en: The time when the instance was scheduled to run
CycTime.description_zh:
实例任务的定时时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

DagId.description_en: The ID of the DAG for the instance in the manually triggered workflow

DagType.description_en: The type of the manually triggered workflow

FinishTime.description_en: The time when the instance finished running
FinishTime.description_zh:
实例任务运行的结束时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

ModifyTime.description_en: The time when the instance was last modified
ModifyTime.description_zh:
最近一次修改实例任务的时间。

格式示例为 13 位数字，例如 `1605178414676`

NodeId.description_en: The ID of the node in the manually triggered workflow

ParamValues.description_en: The parameters related to the instance

Status.description_en:
The status of the instance. Valid values:

NOT_RUN: The instance is not run.
WAIT_TIME: The instance is waiting for its scheduling time to arrive.
WAIT_RESOURCE: The instance is waiting for resources.
RUNNING: The instance is running.
CHECKING: Data quality is being checked for the instance.
CHECKING_CONDITION: Branch conditions are being checked for the instance.
FAILURE: The instance fails to be run.
SUCCESS: The instance is successfully run
Status.description_zh:
实例任务的状态，取值如下：

NOT_RUN（未运行）
WAIT_TIME（等待定时时间DueTime或CycleTime到来）
WAIT_RESOURCE（等待资源）
RUNNING（运行中）
CHECKING（下发给数据质量进行数据校检）
CHECKING_CONDITION（正在进行分支条件校检）
FAILURE（执行失败）
SUCCESS（执行成功）

TaskType.description_en:
The scheduling type of the node. Valid values:

NORMAL(0): The node is an auto triggered node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node.
MANUAL(1): The node is a manually triggered node. The scheduling system does not regularly run the node.
PAUSE(2): The node is a frozen node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node but sets the status of the node to failed when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
SKIP(3): The node is a dry-run node. The scheduling system regularly runs the node but sets the status of the node to successful when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4): The node is an unselected node in a temporary workflow. This type of node exists only in temporary workflows. The scheduling system sets the status of the node to successful when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
SKIP_CYCLE(5): The node is a node that is scheduled by week or month and is waiting for the scheduling time to arrive. The scheduling system regularly runs the node but sets the status of the node to successful when the scheduling system starts to run the node.
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6): The node is not selected by its ancestor branch node and is run as a dry-run node.
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7): The node has instances that are generated in real time but deprecated. The scheduling system sets the status of the node to successful
TaskType.description_zh:
实例任务的调度类型，取值如下：

NORMAL(0)：正常调度任务。该任务被日常调度。
MANUAL(1)：手动任务。该任务不会被日常调度。
PAUSE(2)：冻结任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为失败状态。
SKIP(3)：空跑任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_UNCHOOSE(4)：临时工作流中未选择的任务，仅存在于临时工作流中，启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
SKIP_CYCLE(5)：未到运行周期的周或月任务。该任务被日常调度，但启动调度时直接被置为成功状态。
CONDITION_UNCHOOSE(6)：上游实例中有分支（IF）节点，但是该下游节点未被分支节点选中，直接置为空跑任务。
REALTIME_DEPRECATED(7)：实时生成的已经过期的周期实例，该类型的任务直接被置为成功状态
